import json
from tabulate import tabulate

def test_bug():
    json_data = '''[
        {
            "column1": "data",
            "column2": 123,
            "column3": true,
            "column4": null
        },
        {
            "column1": "Longer string",
            "column2": 123,
            "column3": true,
            "column4": null
        }
    ]'''
    parsed_data = json.loads(json_data)
    result = tabulate(parsed_data, headers="keys", tablefmt="github")
    expected = "\n".join([
        "| column1       |   column2 | column3   | column4   |",
        "|:--------------|----------:|:----------|:----------|",
        "| data          |       123 | True      |           |",
        "| Longer string |       123 | True      |           |"
    ])
    assert result == expected
